response_contract.format: Original LZW-compressed WSF3D V02 BuildingHeight GeoTIFF file, not rendered WMS PNG preview; exact TIFF layout, total original byte count, CRS, scale, nodata and native numeric values remain untested.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: DLR WSF 3D v02 provides globally gridded average building height in metres at nominal 90 m resolution. The version-specific layer measures aggregated building height, not individual surveyed building storeys, insured replacement value, number of structures, flood vulnerability, observed storm damage or insurer losses. The small single southern-African tile is a future technical sample only, never a representative global or independent urban accuracy benchmark.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: DLR EOC Geoservice AUP v1.1 governs the DLR Download Service. The source-specific CC BY 4.0 licence does not specify automated transfer cadence. AUP requires non-disruptive use and reserves enforcement, with no separately established numeric maximum or automated HTTP Range entitlement for this WSF3D V02 file. Thus network mode remains none until a responsible, explicitly reviewed exact single-file or bounded range acquisition is approved.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Official provider file listing observed 2026-11-15 advertises exact WSF3D V02 1x1 degree tile and size approximately 41.1 KiB. A release path is not proof of byte immutability.
